native.scope: Actual checkpoint BF16 W1/W2 on one 910C with fixed synthetic predecessors/base. Full-hit graph uses immutable precomputed M4 rows and keeps BF16 add/argmax. Partial-hit graphs receive preclassified hit/miss lanes and use compact M1–M3 native W2 plus reassembly. No miss classifier timing, cache mutation, HCCL, model replay or workload hit-rate claim.

timing_and_break_even.model_scope: Fixed isolated times. For all-hit lookup plus original W2 on any miss, p*hit_saving > (1-p)*miss_overhead. Mixed thresholds use the measured static reassembly penalty with zero charged classifier cost. No workload or full model latency inference.

saved_id_availability.scope: Separate joint176 EP0 metadata. Scheduler placeholders cannot estimate repeated-token or whole-step hits.

contracts.cache_key: Predecessor in the correct input vocabulary and checkpoint generation; preserve W1/W2 bytes, head dtype, scaling, soft cap, native reduction/shape class and score column ownership. W1 exact row equality provides no extra key merging in this checkpoint.
contracts.all_hit_branch: Use the cached bias, BF16 add and original selector. Validate every lane before reading a slot. On a miss, retain the stock full step in the initial candidate. Do not index the -1 sentinel. Capture/update each valid cache bank and its generation with correct producer/reader fencing.
contracts.mixed_and_column: M1–4 and narrowed columns matched only the sampled real-weight cases. The preclassified mixed route still traverses W2 on any miss and the tested reassembly loses time. Selected columns need an independent score-demand certificate and original tie rules.
contracts.effects: Probabilistic and raw-score readers still need corrected scores in the original order. Keep each ID publication, vocabulary remap, confidence W1 read, budget state and RNG as applicable. A cached bias never supplies the request-dependent base logits.

delivery_choices.packet: Write three BF16 means into checkpoint columns of a per-row packet at the same pre-Engram generation. One rank-ordered gather yields contiguous [N,3,H], whose [N,3H] view feeds the unchanged local BF16 main matmul. A strided mean out was native-value exact in six fixtures. Any backend with an extra stride materialization still needs timing.
delivery_choices.same_M_early: For a source-known prefix, after the third checkpoint and required peers are ready, gather and run main projection/norm on the original M before the sampler. Do not move context copy-expand or cache updates that require verified state. Preserve bit/dtype, positions, events and bank retirement. The measured pre-sampler interval is available placement time under the old schedule, with actual contention and graph timing open.
delivery_choices.late_selected: For truly late nonpadded I, gather unique rows by physical owner and reconstruct original order and duplicates, including valid negative index semantics. A fixed-count collective consumes P*max(U_p) rows; sparse M alone can leave the payload unchanged. Current fixed full prefix has no sparse benefit.
delivery_choices.early_all_then_select: Shape-changing F.linear does not generically preserve BF16 output, even though the row algebra commutes. Two isolated cases show mismatches. Use the same original native M or obtain separate precision acceptance.
delivery_choices.co_pack_current_SWA: A truly late I cannot gate a packet needed by current target attention. Padded known-prefix aux can instead be co-packed per checkpoint with a ready projected SWA tile if group, rank ordering, semantics and its already independent SWA candidate all match. This is a different schedule from deferring all three aux gathers.
delivery_choices.projection_ownership: Current output-channel shards each need all input columns. Partial BF16 sum or reuse of a single shard on the token owner changes semantics. Full-weight token ownership or feature-group replication trades weight bytes, extra row work and collectives. Any checkpoint-K split must preserve the original FP32 recurrence and one BF16 rounding.

work_bounds.accounting: Packet layout may remove IndexCheck/Index/Concat on the certified identity prefix, but does not itself reduce all-row aux payload. Do not add the same checkpoint gather benefit to a per-checkpoint SWA co-pack. Price main projection movement as scheduling and keep its feature gather and RMS.

selected_evidence.scope: Same historical rank clock within each native bracket. Merge complete duration of all typed compute tasks and HCCL envelopes on all streams, including overlap and any protocol waiting. Charge the largest one-rank removable duration per carrier, then recompute the eight request maximum. This sensitivity fixes other arrivals, resource placement, and launch gaps; distributed causal chains with migrating critical ranks require a larger bound.
limits: The complement may include launch gaps, untyped DMA, runtime tasks or synchronization. Its presence does not prove host stalls or that it is removable.
The unpaired triples are separately measured and stay outside the matched request price. A fused expert duration includes its internal communication. Categories may overlap.

slot_overwrite.text_branch: For corrected target start S, U=d+1=6 and valid count c, current target context covers [S,S+U), r=U-c and the draft effective prefix P=S+U-r. Context slots copy the full span. Query logical slot positions are P+q, q in [0,5). The rejected suffix [P,S+U) lies inside the query range if c>=1.
slot_overwrite.physical_gate: For j<min(r,Q), compare saved context slot at segment_end-r+j with that layer's query slot j. Require the same valid byte span, cache owner, group and generation, a full query store, no intervening current/queued observer, and defined duplicate ordering. A pair with differing page or invalid query slot must not be removed by this rule. DCP>1, packed, position-ID remap and prefix/COW variants keep their own ABI and writer guards.
slot_overwrite.zero_commit_counterexample: With S=0, c=0 and Q=5, context row 5 has no replacing query writer. Retain it unless a separate lifetime proof applies.
slot_overwrite.metadata_fusion: Reuse the existing rejection count and per-group row map. Can generate eligibility by deriving the query address in the context work item, or compare finished planes in a later stage. Do not read Part 2 outputs from another program of the same copy-expand launch without a device join.

window_retirement.current: With effective prefix P and window W=128, current context demand is [max(0,P-W),P). Keep the query block and original visible-index ordering.
window_retirement.future: On the same uninterrupted request generation with device correction, next target start is S+c=P. The next effective prefix is P+c_next>=P even if c_next is zero. Thus the current effective cutoff also covers future windows on that branch after earlier queued readers retire. CPU prefill/new/resume, changed groups, shared-prefix observers and reset do not inherit this proof.
window_retirement.uncorrected_counterexample: For S=512,c=1,W=128 the correct lower bound is 385. Using the uncorrected target end S+6 produces 390 and loses five still-visible positions.
window_retirement.union_rule: For each layer keep rows inside any surviving window, rows without a guaranteed final replacement, and all other cache/FP32 observers. A row excluded by both rules is charged once. Prefix/ring horizon cannot replace the explicit physical owner and final-writer checks.

conditional_direct_work.main_gate: Only prune a row before combine_hidden_states if all three layer consumers and any other context-bank readers retire it. A common TP8 compact row order requires the union of every participating peer's demand. A mask inferred from one card's invalid slots can delete a row another card needs. Price any agreement and keep graph addresses, all TP participation, and exact GEMM/RMS/RoPE numerics.
conditional_direct_work.planning: Eligibility inputs are independent of aux hidden values. Move the eligibility descriptor before main while preserving the rest of the mutating proposer order. The gather byte budget assumes one standard BF16 TP8 gather of 640 columns per rank for each retained row.
conditional_direct_work.scope: Counters price a logical candidate row count over each recorded service interval, not a verified device eligibility count, and not the individual v164 profile windows. Static padded execution may still perform the same GEMM. Measure the compacted native rows and weight/dispatch/collective cost before assigning a latency benefit.

AUX_NATIVE_QUALIFICATION.limits: One NPU, synthetic checkpoint and BF16 local projection weights with 8 virtual SP ranks. Packet concat models rank order, no HCCL, graph, target weight content or production time. Shape-changing projection is measured separately from packet layout equivalence.
AUX_NATIVE_QUALIFICATION.scope: One NPU with virtual rank order and native BF16 checkpoint mean and local-width main projection.
AUX_NATIVE_QUALIFICATION.warning: Synthetic projection weights; counterexamples reject generic M-reordering equivalence, not every fixed real-weight/shape candidate.
